name: git-graph-standalone
description: Git Graph Standalone - a desktop Git client with a commit graph, built with Electron. Root project builds the renderer (web/ -> media/); the app itself lives in electron/.

scripts.compile: npm run lint && npm run build:main && npm run build:web
scripts.start: npm run compile && npm --prefix electron run launch
scripts.dist: npm run compile && npm --prefix electron run dist
